body.statement: Along the four-mask path \(z=19/5+\eta\), whenever \(P_\eta\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)\) and \(0<|\eta|\) is sufficiently small, does the nuisance-compensated handle yield laws \(P_{\eta,0},P_{\eta,d}\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)\) with \(|d|=c_0\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\), \(\|\mu(P_{\eta,d})-\mu(P_{\eta,0})\|_\infty\ge c_1|d|\), and \(\operatorname{KL}(P_{\eta,0,O}^{N},P_{\eta,d,O}^{N})\le KNd^2s_N^2\), while observed-moment inversion attains maximal half-width at most \(C_\alpha\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\) on this path?
body.justification: This is the mandatory early-kill obligation: the simple rank-loss path must support same-shell separation and matching inversion before any universal shell converse is credible.
body.gap: The exact minor and local singular root certify algebraic near-rank-loss, but no cited result upgrades that path to legal complete-law alternatives in the identical observable shell.
body.consumer: Failure of shell preservation or target separation on this explicit path stops the universal frontier and identifies the needed quantitative slack restriction.
